build_transformer_decoder: build a transformer decoder model with causal masking and multi-head self-attention layers
create_transformer_config: create a TransformerConfig dataclass with vocab size, embedding dim, num layers, and num heads
create_multihead_attention: create a MultiHeadDotProductAttention module with query, key, value projections and softmax attention
create_position_encoding: create sinusoidal position encodings for transformer sequence inputs using sine and cosine functions
run_transformer_inference: run the transformer decoder to produce log_softmax logits over a vocabulary for input token sequences
